_help: Stage introductions, shown before each stage (in order: stage 0 is The Shire act 1).
Each string in 'text' is a paragraph. Color words with [name]...[/], using a
name from 'colors' or a hex color like [#ff0000]...[/].
Text shows in capitals (the NES font has no readable lowercase) and wraps by itself.
Set "align": "center" on a stage to center its lines.
The font has no ( ) / = characters, but they're drawn specially and work.

text: Time's up Frodo. Pack your things and get to the city of Bree. They are looking for you. Don't use the name Baggins.
You are gonna find your friends along the way. Now, [red]GO![/]
[blue]Sam:[/] Hello Mr. Frodo, can i come to your adventure?
[red]Frodo:[/] Frick you man, i'll see ya at work.
[blue]Sam:[/] Ah Mr. Frodo, Don't hate me Cause i am beautiful. Maybe if you got rid of yours ye-ye ass haircut you'd maybe had met some elves. Now, let's get this going
[blue]Sam:[/] Mr Frodo. I'm scared! I think i saw some terrible monster following our way!!!
[red]Frodo:[/] Come on Sam! A monster worse than those orcs and goblins we've been fighting? I don't think so.
[blue]Sam:[/] Mr Frodo, am i crazy? Or am i so sane that i blew your mind??
After defeating the evil ring-wraith the two ran in the dark to the dark village of Bree, in hopes of finding Gandalf, who had gone missing after talking with Frodo at the shire.
Bree was a dark place. Populated by men and hobbits of all sorts. Even the shadiest ones...
[blue]Sam:[/] Mr. Frodo, i think i just saw David Brent!
[red]Frodo:[/] Who the heck is "David Brent", Sam?
[blue]Sam:[/] That fat guy from the Office, Mr Frodo.
[red]Frodo:[/] Nah Sam, that's just Aragorn. Heir of Isildur, king of Gondor. No big deal.
[blue]Aragorn:[/] Hello, i'm Aragorn. Son of Ararthorn, Heir of Isil-
[red]Frodo:[/] Dude stfu, u gonna say that every damn time?
[blue]Aragorn:[/] Sorry. Also, be cautious with the Ringwraiths.
[red]Frodo:[/] Ok idc

After the Battle with the Ring-wraith, it was just too much for [darkblue]Frodo.[/] He fell to the ground and some very visible wounds started to bleed. "I told you to be careful, little hobbit!" Said [crimson]Aragorn.[/] "Will Mr. Frodo be fine?" [orange]Sam[/] Asked. "Do not worry, my Elf friend [green]Legolas[/] is coming to rescue him, i hope. And we're gonna follow" [crimson]Aragorn[/] responded.

[darkblue]Frodo[/] blacked out. Once he woke up he found himself in a magical Evilsh valley known as Rivendell. [gray]Gandalf,[/] [crimson]Aragorn[/] and [green]Legolas[/] were all there. [blue]Elrond[/] an elvish lord, said "Five companions, So be it! I declare you the [gold]FELLOWSHIP OF THE RING[/]"
The fellowship marched through the misty mountains and found themselves in...
[gray]Gandalf:[/] I think we took the wrong route...
[crimson]Aragorn:[/] What? How?
[gray]Gandalf:[/] I'm sorry.
As the fellowship walked through the snowy mountains of Caradhras they found the Magical Door of Durin. It was their only way out. The door opened and they heard a giant hoar inside.
[gray]Gandalf:[/] STAY HERE and DON'T FOLLOW ME! I've got a bad feeling about this!
